tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi dkar chag gtsigs kyi yi ge zhib mo bzhugs/na mo pad+ma badz+rā ya/gtsigs kyi yi ge zhib mo bkod pa/ngo mtshar rmad du byung bar
༄༅/ /zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi dkar chag gtsigs kyi yi ge zhib mo bzhugs/na mo pad+ma badz+rā ya/gtsigs kyi yi ge zhib mo bkod pa/ngo mtshar rmad du byung bar

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi dkar chag gtsigs

kyi yi ge zhib mo bzhugs/ na mo pad+ma badz+rā ya/ gtsigs kyi yi ge zhib mo bkod pa/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung bar gyur pa la phyag 'tshal la ོ / /sngon gyi dge tshogs dpag med las 'khrungs pa'i/ /'jig rten mgon po'i dam chos rin chen gter/ /gangs can khrod 'dir snang mdzad chos rgyal dang*/ /lo paṇa dpag med zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gang gis thos na ngo mtshar skyed byed cing*/ /'phrul gyi bkod pa ya mtshan gsal byed pa/ /gtsigs kyi yi ge zhib mo 'bul lags kyi/ /dad ldan skye bo'i tshogs rnams gzigs par gsol/ /de la gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i zhing khams/ stong gsum nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar gnas pa'i bcu gsum pa thugs kar dpal gyi be'u la brten pa stong gsum mi mjed kyi 'jig rten las/ gling bzhi pa bar ma'i rang bzhin ri rab lho'i 'dzam bu gling*/ thub pa bcom ldan 'das sprul pa'i sku mngon par byang chub pa'i gnas/ bsod nams bsags pa las kyi sa pa khyad par skye ba'i yul las/ khyad par dpal ldan gangs ri'i khrod bod chen po dge ba can gyi yul 'dir/ sngon gyi chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dbu brnyes/ srol btod/ dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa las/ /khyad par du gnam lha babs kyi rgyal pa ོ / sa lhun grub kyi mnga' bdag /'grengs mgo nag yongs kyi spyi rje/ sprul pa'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la/ dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ za hor gyi mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho rab tu bzang pa ོ / siṅga la'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bhi ma la mi tra la sogs pa spyan drangs nas/ bstan pa'i gzhi ma dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen pa ོ / mtha' 'dul yang 'dul dang bcas pa brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzhengs shing*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad pa las da dung yang mtha'i so kha ma non cing*/

dus ma yin pa'i sa g.yo ba la sogs pa 'byung po'i gnod pa dang*/ bdud srin po'i cho 'phrul du ma 'byung zhing*/ phyir rabs na yang bod chen po'i yul 'dir mtha' dmag dang 'byung po'i gnod pas lo nyes dang*/ mu ge dang*/ nad dang*/ mtshon dang*/ phyi nang gi 'khrugs 'tshe du ma 'byung bar dgongs nas/ de 'dul ba'i gnyen por lo paṇa rje blon dang bcas pa rnams bka' bgros te/ rdzogs pa chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i nyang ting 'dzin bzang po la mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs par gsol nas/ dbu ru stod kyi sbral nas smad kyi mar gnon la thug pa mthun pa'i rkyen du gnang ste nyang gi rigs rgyud du gtogs pa gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i gtsigs g.yung drung du gnang ba rdo ring gi ngos la gsal bar bkod pa bzhin bka' gnang ba dang*/ btsan 'bangs rin po che ste/ gzhi'i nang mchog tu rje la byas pa che zhing glo ba nye ba/ nyang snang bzang 'dul kong gi bu thu bo ban+de ting 'dzin bzang pos rje'i bka' lung gus pas mnos te/ bod yul kun tu phan pa'i las chen po byas pa ni/ spyir bod kyi yul du gnod pa'i mtha' dmag dang 'byung po shar nas yod pas/ de'i dgra chen po yang shar na gnas te/ de gang na 'dug ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas gzigs pas/ sbral mda' phur pa'i dbal so lta bu yod par mkhyen te/ de yang shar ri hor sog chas pa 'dra ba/ lho ri glang chen g.yul zhugs 'dra ba/ nub ri bdud dpung 'gyings pa 'dra ba/ nub byang hom khung gtad pa 'dra ba/ byang ri stag seng 'thab pa 'dra ba/ chu mgul ral gri gdengs pa 'dra ba/ sa gzhi lpags rlon brgyangs pa 'dra ba/ sa stod gru gsum phur rtse 'dra ba/ sa smad gshin rje'i rba dong 'dra ba/ steng gi gnam gru gsum/ 'og gi sa gru gsum/ bar gyi ri gru gsum du gnas pa'i gnam sa'i 'dzoms kyi dbus su/ zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi gzhal yas khang mtha' dmag dang 'byung po 'dul ba'i mchog phur du btab pa ni/

bgegs dpung dbus su rang byung he ru ka / sngon tshe gzir gnon drag pos btul ba bzhin/ /bod yul sa 'dul gtsug lag khang 'di yang*/ /mtha' dmag bgegs dang 'byung po 'dul ba mtshar/ /dpung tshogs nang du dpa' bo chas pa bzhin/ /pha rol dgra sde rab tu pham byas nas/ /rang phyogs rnam par rgyal ba'i phyogs 'dzin pas/ /sngon med rgyal ba'i dpa' bo byon pa snyam/ /bod yul kun gyi gnod pa zlog pa dang*/ /phan pa sgrub pa rig sngags mchod sdong bzhin/ /bde legs spel ba'i yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ /mtshungs par gyur la gus pas phyag 'tshal la ོ / /de ltar 'jigs shing 'dul dka' ba'i sa phyogs dur khrod gsang ba mchog dang 'dra bar ye shes 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang chen po bzhugs su gsol ba yang*/ sa mi 'gyur ba rdo rje'i lte ba/ bar mi 'gyur ba bkra shis kyi bang rim/ gnam mi 'gyur ba rin po che'i 'phyang gur gsum la dmigs btsal te/ sa gzhi ko rlon brgyangs pa lta bu mtha' dmag gi blar bcas pa sa gru gsum hom khung lta bu'i nang du bsdus/ phyogs kyi sa dgra rang gshed rang la phab pa dbus su zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi gzhal yas khang gzir gnon drag po'i mchog phur du btab nas/ chos dang nor gyi gter kha du mas brgyan pa la/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas/mkhas pa bi ma la mi tra/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang po rnams kyis sa 'og 'byung po'i gnon pa dang*/ bkra shis bde legs kyi rten 'brel du ma mdzad de/ rab tu gnas pa lan bdun bdun snga phyi rim gyis mdzad pa'i tshe/ nang gi lder so rnams phyir byon nas slar snga ma'i gnas su bzhugs pa dang*/ nam mkha' las lha'i bu rnams kyis mchod pa'i char 'bebs pa la sogs pa bkra shis kyi dge mtshan du ma mngon sum du byung ba bod 'bangs yongs kyis mthong bas ngo mtshar du gyur pa lags sa ོ / /de yang kun gyi spyi bor brten par 'os pa dang*/ dam can rdo rje legs pas 'bru'i phud zhwa spyi rtol du phul ba las bzhengs pa'i phyir/

zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi lha khang zhes grags sa ོ / /dus ring rgyal ba'i thugs rje rmad byung dang*/ /gangs can skye dgu yongs kyi bsod nams las/ / gtsigs kyi nor bu zhwa yi gtsug lag khang*/ /ting 'dzin bzang po 'phags pa'i thugs rjes bsgrub/ /rten rnams kun kyang dngos su rang byon zhing*/ /lha rnams kun kyang me tog char pa 'bebs/ /mi rnams kun kyang ngo mtshar yid dbang g.yo/ / phyogs rnams kun kyang bkra shis bde legs gyur/ /'di yi ngo mtshar bsod nams gzi 'od kyis/ /bod yul bde zhing rje 'bangs dgongs pa 'grub/ / mtha' rnams non zhing 'du ba phun sum tshogs/ /mi dbang gling bzhi 'khor los sgyur rgyal bzhin/ /de 'dra'i ngo mtshar gtsug lag khang chen 'di/ /rgyu bzang bkod legs rang byung 'phrul gyi bzo/ /byas pa mi 'dra lhun gyis grub pa 'dra/ /'og min dag pa'i zhing la 'gran pa bzhin/ /rgyal bas byin brlabs ngo mtshar rmad kyi rten/ /dad ldan rnams kyi thar pa'i them skas mchog /skye dgu'i don sgrub mdzad la dge legs bzhin/ /tshu rol mthong ba'i yul las 'das so kye/ /de ltar ngo mtshar mchog gis brgyan pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di bzhengs pa'i mthu dpal gyis/ bod yul tsam du bde skyid dpal 'bar zhing*/ rje blon kun gyi dgongs pa yid bzhin du 'grub nas mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam bzang bstan pa lags so/ /'di ni re 'dod yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu rgyal mtshan rtse mor byon/ /phongs pa kun las nges sgrol ba'i/ /dngos grub yid bzhin char pa 'bebs/ /'di ni srid gsum 'gro ba'i gnyen/ /skyabs mdzad dpung gnyen mchog tu byon/ /'jigs pa kun las nges par grol/ /dbang phyug skye dgu'i re ba skong*/ /'di ni phan bde'i yid bzhin sprin/ /tshangs dbyangs lha yi rnga sgra byon/ /nyes pa kun las nges sgrol ba'i/ /yon tan char gyi tshogs mang bkye/ /de lta bu'i gtsug lag khang 'dis ni bod kyi yul kun tu 'jug pa'i mtha' dmag dang 'byung po'i 'tshe ba thams cad skyob cing*/

yul gyi so kha dang mtshams dag bsrung bar byas pa yin te/ 'phags pa glang ru lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ ma 'ongs pa'i rtsod pa'i dus na yul 'di gzhom pa'i phyir sum pa'i dmag phal mo che dang*/ gru gu rus sna tshogs dang*/ hor dang*/ gzhan yang dad pa med pa dag 'ong bar 'gyur te/ de'i yul gzhan dang gzhan nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan byin gyis brlabs pa dag yul 'dir gshegs nas/ yul gyi sa mtshams srung bar mdzad de/ bsod nams kyi stobs des yul 'di gtan brlag par mi 'gyur ra ོ / /byang phyogs kyi yul zhwa zhes bya bar sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan shen zhwa zhes bya bar 'og gi 'jig rten nas 'byung bar 'gyur zhing yul gyi sa mtshams bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang yul 'dir nga'i gzugs brnyan chen po shing rtar 'dren par byas te/ mkhar dge ba can zhes bya ba'i nang du bzhag nas mchod gnas chen po byed par 'gyur ro/ /gnod pa rnams kyang zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te rgya'i dmag mchi bar 'gyur na de dag gi sems dad par 'gyur zhing*/ slar yul 'di la phan 'dogs pa dang*/ phyis yul 'dir bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dge ba dang*/ gtsug lag khang tshar ma la sogs pa/ yul byin gyis brlabs pa rnams su theg pa chen po'i mdo sde'i sde snod sna tshogs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ 'dus pa rin po che'i tog dang*/ sangs rgyas phal po che dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa la sogs pa shin tu rgyas pa'i sde mang po klogs shig dang*/ yul so so nas byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu la sogs pa dang*/ mthu stobs chen po'i sems can de dag yul 'dir 'ongs nas/ chos kyi ro mnos shing dus gsum du gtogs pa rnams kyis dam tshig las mi 'gal bar byed/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod yul dang*/ yul yang srung bar byed/ yul 'di'i mi dang bstan pa yang bsrung bar 'gyur ra

ོ / /zhes gsungs so/ /de la glang ru lung bstan pa'i yul ni/ bod chen po yin la/ ri glang ru lha sa lcags po ri dang dmar po ri yin zhing*/ gzugs brnyan shing rta la gdan 'dren pa sngon jo bo rgya nag nas gdan drang ba ste/ mkhar dge ba can 'phrul snang yin la/ gtsug lag khang tshar ma ra mo che la sogs sa ོ / /'gyur kha cig tu byang phyogs kyi yul shwa zhes bya bar zhes pa ni/ skad kyi byings 'dra ba la lo tswa phyi mas ma 'gyur bar zad mod/ sngon gyi 'gyur chen dag las zhwa zhes bsgyur bar yin pa'i phyir/ gtsug lag khang 'di yi mtshan du shes par bya'o/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po 'di bod yul gtsug lag khang kun dang*/ khyad par du lha sa bsam yas kyi 'ob rags lta bu yin pas/ 'di ci tsam du dar zhing rgyas pa de srid du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang gtsug lag khang sde dgon dang bcas pa thams cad dar rgyas su 'gyur la/ 'di gud na'ang 'ob rags zhig pa'i yul ltar gzhan rnams myur du gog pa ོ ra 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gtsug lag khang 'di mchog tu gnyan pas gso ba dang*/ mchod pa 'bul ba la brtson par bya' ོ / /༈ de ltar yin pa'i gtan tshigs che long du bkod pa ni/ sngon gyi rgyal blon rnams 'das nas ring zhig na/ gtsug lag khang 'di mchod pa'i rkyen du ma bab cing mchod pa dang*/ bkur sti byed pa med pa las/ bod 'dir nad dang mu ge dang*/ nang 'khrugs la sogs pa'i gnod pa mang du byung ngo*/ /de'i 'og tu phyogs kyi mchod rten zhig pa las/ rgyal po glang gis bstan pa bsnubs pa nas bzung ste/ 'bangs khengs log /mi rje yul phyung*/ bod nang 'khrugs nas mi bde ba du ma byung ngo*/ /de nas dge ba can dag gis sngon gyi yig tshang las byung ba ltar cung zad gsos shing mchod pa phul ba las/ bstan pa bar dar dkon mchog gi nyi ma shar ba yin na ོ / /de'i 'og tu 'dod sred can dag gis gtsigs kyi khang bu phyes nas gter phyung*/

gtsug lag khang gi sa gnon gyi me btsa' nyams su bcug pa las/ lho ri nas sa rol gyi klong rdol bas sman grong shwas mnan/ gtsug lag khang gi dgrar song bas bags kyis gogs pa la brten nas/ bod yul du shwa 'ud dang nad dang mu ge la sogs pa'i mi rung ba mang du byung ngo*/ /de nas ring zhig na bdud kyi rigs can kha cig gis sgo khang steng nas gter brus pas ring 'thag lto sbyar nus thod pa kha sbyar 'phur te mi rung ba'i sgra byung*/ chag pa'i sgrog ral bas bod yul du lo nyes/ so kha hor la shor/ de'i phyi lo la yang bdud kyi sprul pa dag gis sgo khang dang 'khor sa mes bsregs pas hor gyi dmag rdol/ bod 'bangs mtshon gyis nyen/ mi rung ba sna tshogs pa byung*/ de nas cung zhig na dge ba can 'gas phyi nang gog sa pa cung zad gsos/ mchod pa'i rkyen sbyar ba las bod yul 'jam bde/ phyi nang gi 'khrugs 'tshe med pa la dar zhing gnas so/ /de nas bstan pa mar 'gribs pas lha la mchod pa med/ gtsug lag khang du bud med dang ba glang zhugs pas gogs shing 'o brgyal/ de'i rten 'brel gyi bod kyi lha khang sde dgon phal cher sgog / mi rung ba sna tshogs byung ngo*/ /de nas dus kyi tha ma la yul 'di'i mi rnams kyi snying du bdud dang rgyal 'gong zhugs pas gtsug lag khang 'jig pa'i mgo brtsams te/ bgegs rigs ngo tsha dang bral ba'i skye bo khrel med pa rnams kyis rgya phibs dang*/ dbu rtse bshigs/ bdud rigs dam las log pa'i rab tu byung ba dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ltar bcos pa rnams kyis mdo dang ltag rol bshig /nye ba'i mtshams med pa byas nas ngan song mu mtha' med pa'i las byas pa la brten nas/ byed pa po de dag la tshe 'dir mthong ba'i chos su tshe thung ba dang*/ rgyal po'i chad pa dang*/ ser bas nyen pa la sogs pa mi rung ba sna dgu byung*/ bod yul tsam du lo chu dus su mi smin/ than pa dang sad ser mod/

shwa 'ud dang chu 'byams rdol/ sa g.yos dang rlung dmar ldang*/ nyi zla yang yang shi/ rgyu skar gyi khrom 'gros byed/ tshes kyi lhag chad mang*/ drang srong gi gnod pa dang*/ glo bur gyi ye 'drogs mang*/ bgegs rigs kyi mtha' mi yong*/ phyi nang gi 'khrugs 'tshe sbyor/ dmag rigs sna dgu rdol/ bcom phrog dang bsad shi mang*/ nad mtshon dang mu ge dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi mtsho brdol nas mtha' dang dbus su 'khrug cing bde ba'i go skabs med pa thams cad kun gyis dran par byung ba yin no/ /gang du yid bzhin rin chen stor ba na/ /phyogs der bde ba'i go skabs med pa ltar/ /gtsug lag khang 'di zhig pas bod yul 'dir/ /gnod pa'i tshogs rab char du 'bab pa yin/ /grong rnams gong gi thog ma'i rags zhig na/ /ring por mi thogs chu bos nyen pa ltar/ /gtsug lag khang 'di zhig pas yod yul 'dir//mi bde'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs byung ba yin/ /g.yul ngor thog mar dpa' bo nyam nyes na/ /dpung tshogs thams cad myur du pham pa ltar/ / gtsug lag khang 'di zhig pas bod yul 'dir/ /mtha' dmag la sogs nyes kun byung ba yin/ /rgyal srid yul gyi so kha shor ba na/ /ring por mi thogs yul khams 'chor ba ltar/ /gtsug lag khang 'di zhig pas bod yul 'dir/ /

gtsug lag khang kun 'jig cing nyams par 'gyur/ /de phyir bod yul kun gyi gtsug lag khang*/ /'di bas gnyan pa gzhan na yod min pas/ /cung zad tsam yang nyams su mi 'jug cing*/ /phyi rabs dad 'byor blo dang ldan rnams kyis/ / gso dang bsrung dang mchod la brtson par mdzod//bod yul gtsug lag khang kun gsos dang mnyam/ /de phyir bde zhing myur du sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /gzhan don dge ba can rnams 'grub 'gyur la/ /bstan pa nub ka'i nyi ma bsring bar 'gyur/ /bod yul phan bde'i lhag ma bzung 'gyur la/ /myur du don gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /de nas ji zhig na sngon gyi 'phags pa'i rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ khyad par du dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bod kha ba can gyi zhing khams la brtse ba'i thugs rje chen po skyes te/ sbyin bdag dad pa can rnams thar pa'i lam la bskyal ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ gtsug lag khang gso ba'i phrin las mdzad pa ni/ gdul bya rnams kyi dkar po rnam par 'phel ba'i dbang gis te/ gang dag gang zhig tshogs pa las legs pa dam pa byung ba'i rgyu 'bras la gzigs shing*/ de dang de la byin gyis brlab pa'i mthu stobs 'jug par mdzad pa ni 'phags pa rnams kyi chos nyid da ོ / /nyi zer gsal bas phye ba'i ge sar dang*/ /dgung zla'i 'od kyis dngar ba'i ku mud ltar/ /thugs rje'i zer gyis gdul bya'i mkhar khyab pa/ /rab dkar dge legs snang ba gsal byed yin/ /mkhyen brtse'i dus sprin g.yos pas mdzes pa gang*/ /'jig rten re 'dod rnams la lha yi chu/ / bdud rtsi'i char zim 'bab pas dga' ba gang*/ /sa steng 'gro la de ltar snang ba yin//sngon nas goms pa'i dad pa rlabs chen la/ /'dir yang 'bad pa'i brtson pa shugs drag pos/ /dus la bab tshe dge la spro ba gang*/ /yid ltar mgyogs pa'i shugs kyis de rab 'grub/ /dge ba'i brtson pa gang la dge ba yi/

/lha rnams kyis kyang dge ba'i grogs byed cing*/ /de yi mos dge phun tshogs de mthong nas//dge ba'i bshes kyis de yi dge legs spel/ /de yang 'phags pa'i thugs rje rmad du byung ba'i 'od zer dang*/ rang gi legs par byas pa'i las dang smon lam gyi 'phro sad pa la brten te/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i 'dabs su skyes shing*/ o rgyan pad+mas byin gyis brlabs pa rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer dang*/ sku tshe snga ma'i rabs dpag tu med pa nas bsod nams kyi stobs mnga' thang chen pos dbang 'byor pas/ 'dir yang rigs dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs shing*/ chab srid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa la mnga' brnyes pas skye dgu rnams kyi gtso bor gyur cing*/ bsod nams kyi stobs kyis pha rol gyi sde dpung zil gyis gnon pa'i skal pa bzang po can/ dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdag mi'i yang dag phul/ slob dpon kun dga' 'od zer rin chen gyi zhal snga nas/ sngon gyi smom lam bzang po'i las mthun pas lhan cig tu 'dzom ste/ 'phral dang yun du phan pa'i bka' bgros chos su gsol zhing*/ khyad par du bod 'bangs yongs la phan pa'i don du zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi gtsug lag khang gso bar snyan bskul ba las/ legs pa'i don rlabs po che khur du bzhes te/ nang mi che phra kun dang phyi nang gi bka' 'khor dge ba can zho shas 'bul ba kun la bka' bsgo las/ dpon gnyer chen po tshul khrims rin chen gyis dka' ba dang du bzhes nas dgos pa'i tshogs chas sbyar/ dpon yig gzhon nu bkra shis kyis theg pa khur du khur nas sna zin kyi gzhi blangs/ dpon brgya dpon dang*/ phyi ma mgon po rin chen gyis dge ba phyag len la btab nas mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar te/ sa mo glang gi lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig la gtsug lag khang gog po'i phung po gcig tu gyur pa'i sa rdo sol ba la zhugs nas/

bdag cag dpon slob tu gtogs pas kyang sngon gyi yig tshang dang mthun par gtsug lag khang bsgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung zhing myur du 'grub pa'i rten 'brel la zhugs te/ yi ge brgya pa 'bum ther gyi thun gyis chag nyams bskang ba dang*/ zab mo yum gyi bsgrubs pas bgegs dang bar chad bzlog pa dang*/ sāts+tsha 'bum ther gyi rim pas yon mchod bzo rig pa dang bcas pa'i bar chad bzlog cing myur du 'grub pa'i thabs su bya ba dang*/ chu gtor 'bum ther gyi rim pas sa bdag klu gnyan skong ba dang*/ srung ma skong gso'i rim pas rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa dang / sde dgon rnams su mang ja 'bul nod kyi rim pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas gtsug lag khang gi mthun rkyen 'byor par bya ba dang*/ ri rgya dang*/ klung rgya dang*/ chu rgya dang*/ lam rgya btsugs nas mnga' 'og 'jam bder byas pas bod 'bangs yongs la phan pa'i rten 'brel du bsgrubs te/ gtsug lag khang gso ba'i sngon 'gro rnams rdzogs par grub pa na/ yul khams rnams su gtam gyi mtshan ma bzang po/ gser dang*/ 'bru dang*/ shing gi gter thon to zhes bya ba dang*/ grub bo zhes bya ba'i sgra grags te/ yod byad de dag gis phongs pa med pa dang*/ myur du bar chad med par grub pa'i snga ltas su shes so/ /de nas zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gcig nas/ bzo rig pa phal cher 'tshogs nas gtsug lag khang gi rmings bres te bzhengs su gsol ba'i rim pa la bkod pa mkhan po'i bzo bo ni/ mdo rgyud kyi gnas dang khyad par du sngon gyi gtsug lag khang gi rgyus la mkhas pa kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyis mdzad/ shing bzo ba ni/ bod yul kun na mkhas pa dpon bsod nams mgon po yab sras la sogs pas byas/ lha bzo ba ni/ gangs can gyi khrod na lder ris kyis gnas la 'gran zla dang bral ba'i slob dpon kun mkhyen bsod nams bzang po yab sras la sogs pa dang*/

dbu ru stod gsum na mkhas pa ri mo mkhan dpon rgya ma lha bzo yab sras la sogs pas mdzad/ mchod rten pa ni/ mdo rgyud kyi don la mkhas pa'i slob dpon 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas mdzad/ yig mkhan ni mkhas pa'i rab tu gyur pa tshul khrims dpal gyis mdzad/ lcags mgar ba ni/ dbu ru stod gsum na mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa dpon a 'bum la sogs pas mdzad/ zhal la ba ni/ stod gsum gang na mkhas pa'i yang rab dbon rgya ma bas mdzad/ brtsig bzo ba ni/ stod smad kun na mkhas pa'i dpon rin chen skyabs kyis mdzad nas/ bzo bo kun kyang so so'i bzo rigs la brtson zhing*/ rus su thon pas gzab ste/ sngon ji ltar yod pa'i bkod pa bzhin myur du 'grub par byas so/ /ched du ma byas rang bzhin sprul pa'i bzo/ /sngon gyi 'phags pa rnams la 'gran pa bzhin/ /rgyu bzang bkod legs lta bas chog mi shes/ /dpal gyi bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa 'dra/ /brtsigs shing zhal ba lder ris lha rnams kyi/ /bkod pa rnam pa bzo khyad gang yin kun/ /brtags shing ngo mtshar gzhan dang mtshungs pa med/ /phyi rabs dus na sprul pa'i rnam par mtshon/ /myur du grub dang khyad par 'phags pa dang*/ /dge mtshan mchog dang gnod pa med pa'i phyir/ /sprul par 'os te shin tu brtag par gyis/ /'phags pa rnams kyis byin rlabs yin par nges/ /'di yi rmang 'tshol brtsigs shing thog 'bubs dang*/ /bang so ri mo brtsam pa la sogs dus/ /dang ba'i mkha' la 'ja' tshon gur phub pas/ /gzhan las 'phags so 'phags pa'i thugs rje kyai/ /de ltar yang bzo rig dang bkod pa ji lta bur gnas she na/ /sngon ji ltar yod pa ltar bzhengs te/ slob dpon chen po pad+mas gtsug lag khang rnying pa gso ba'i thabs bstan pa dang*/ bzo gnas 'phrul gyi me long du bsam yas bzhengs dus kyi sprul pa'i bzo chen rnams kyi bzhed pa dang*/ rten 'brel bkod pa las 'byung ba dang bstun te/

'di yang thams cad la phan pa'i rten 'brel gyis bzhengs su gsol ba ni/ tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa/ bod yul kun gyi sa yi rten phur mchog /rgyal ba'i rten gsum ngo mtshar rmad byung gi /gtsug lag khang chen yun du gnas byas phyir/ /lho yi phyogs su sa mig me btsa' ni/ /glang chen sna la ral gri btags 'dra'i gdong*/ /gtsigs kyi khang bu sngon bzhin legs par gsos/ /mtha' dmag 'byung po'i gnod pa bzlog pa dang*/ /phyi nang 'khrug 'tshe zhi ba'i rten 'brel du// gtsug lag khang sgo shar bstan phyi yi dbyibs/ /bdud 'dul mchod rten zur mang lugs su bzhengs/ /sa dgra bsrung phyir phyi nang lcags ri'i steng*/ /rtsa brgyad mchod rten kun nas 'khor bar bzhengs/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa dar bya'i phyir/ /nang dbyibs bkod pa dkyil 'khor lugs su bzhengs/ /yul khams tsam du phun sum tshogs bya'i phyir/ /zhal rim lnga lngas rtsigs ngos mdzes par byas/ /'di dag rdo bzo zhal ba'i rten 'brel lags/ /shing bzo rnam bkod rten 'brel shis pa ni/ /rje 'bangs klad non rim gyis che bya'i phyir/ /shing rnams mdo phug steng 'og 'tshams par bkod/ /dbu rmog btsan zhing gong na med bya'i phyir/ /lte ba rgyal po'i sa ste mtho bar phub/ /mnga' dbang 'byor pa chos la spyod bya'i phyir/ /bcu gsum brtsegs rnams gzhal yas khang ltar bkod/ /gdung rabs brgyud pa yun du gnas bya'i phyir/ /skor khang btsun mo'i sa ste 'khor bar phub/ /bka' blon che dgu btsan zhing che ba'i phyir/ /mda' khang blon po'i sa ste mtho bar phub/ /yul khams 'dun zhing mnga' 'og chud bya'i phyir/ /phyi khyams 'bangs kyi sa ste dma' bar phib/ /ban bon rnams kyi mthu rtsal rgyas bya'i phyir/ /ka ba chu srin ka los brgyan par byas/ /rigs gsum skye bo rgyun du 'du bya'i phyir/ /sgo khyams ka ba 'bar ba ris su gtsug

/phyogs kyi bka' blon mnga' btsan che bya'i phyir/ /sgo khang mtho zhing yul phyogs mthong bar phib/ /rje 'bangs btsan zhing rim gyis che bya'i phyir/ /phyi nang phib rnams gong 'og phyed par phib/ /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs bya'i phyir/ /shing bzo'i rnam bkod sngon gyi lugs ltar bzhengs/ /lder tsho'i rnam bkod rten 'brel shis pa la/ /bod 'bangs bde skyid dpal du 'bar ba dang*/ /sbyin bdag bka' sbyin btsan 'byor che ba dang*/ /dge ba'i bshes rnams sku tshe ring ba dang*/ /'gro kun nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' ba dang*/ /thams cad bde ldan zhing du skye ba'i phyir/ /pho brang lte ba gtsang khang dbus ma ru/ /pad+ma dbang chen zhi ba'i skur bstan pa/ /mgon po tshe dpag med kyi gtso 'khor bzhengs/ /bgegs rnams gzhom zhing gsang sngags dar ba dang*/ /lo paṇa 'byung zhing dam chos bsgyur ba dang*/ /nges don dar zhing spyod pa mang ba dang*/ /bsam gtan pa rnams sgrub pa 'phel bya'i phyir/ /gtsang khang lho mar o rgyan gtso 'khor bzhengs/ /thub pa'i bstan pa mtshan nyid theg pa la/ /'chang nyan dar zhing mkhas pa mang ba dang*/ /sdom brtson dam pa kun gyis bkur bya'i phyir/ /gtsang khang byang mar thub pa bcom ldan 'das/ /bā ra ṇā sir 'khor lo bskor ba yi/ /gtso 'khor bkod pa ngo mtshar rmad byung bzhengs/ /mtha' dmag bzlog cing bgegs chen gnon pa dang*/ /sa g.yos me chu 'byung ba'i gnod pa dang*/ /nad dang 'khrugs long gnod 'tshe zhi bya'i phyir/ /dbus su rigs lnga'i phra men mchod rten bzhengs/ /bstan pa bsrung zhing gtsug lag skyong ba dang*/ /rten gsum 'jig pa'i gnod byed bsgral ba dang*/ / dmag dpung rgyal zhing dgra sde gzhom pa'i phyir/ /mgon khang bka' srung chen po gtso 'khor bzhengs/ /ri mo rnam bkod rten 'brel shis pa la/ /bod 'bangs mi rnams tshe srog brtan pa dang*/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po sku tshe ring bya'i phyir/

/lte ba nang lta ye shes 'od lnga'i klong*/ /mgon po tshe dpag med kyi zhing khams bzhengs/ /yul khams 'byor zhing rtag tu dge ba dang*/ /nad gdon 'jigs pa ma lus zhi ba'i phyir/ /lte ba'i phyir lta zhing bkod rnam gsum dang*/ /rang byon lha bzhir bcas pa'i zhing khams bzhengs/ /yul khams dar zhing mi rnams 'byor pa dang*/ /sde dgon rgyas shing bstan pa gnas bya'i phyir/ /skor khang nang lta bskal pa bzang po bzhengs/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis skye dgu 'dul ba dang*/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos rnams rgyas bya'i phyir/ /khyams kyi lho phyogs chos rje'i zhing bkod dang*/ /rgyal ba'i yum gsum rnam bkod rgyud ris bzhengs/ /gsang chen bla med bstan pa dar bya'i phyir/ /glo 'bur lho mar 'khor 'das kun gyi dpal/ /kun bzang chos rje bla ma'i zhing khams bzhengs/ /bod yul dad ldan skye bo'i tshogs rnams kun/ /rlabs chen spyod pas byang chub tshol ba dang*/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod dar bya'i phyir/ khyams kyi byang phyogs nor bzang rgyud ris bzhengs/ /theg gsum chos kyi 'khor lo rgyas pa dang*/ /thar lam zin nas grol ba mang bya'i phyir/ /glo 'bur byang mar lnga sde bzang po dang*/ /brgyad khri'i lha rnams dam chos nyan pa bzhengs/ /sbyin bdag rlabs chen tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang*/ /mnga' thang dpal 'byor rab tu rgyas bya'i phyir/ /khyams smad yar lta ka sgrom gong rol la/ /sbyin bdag 'khor bcas mchod pa 'bul ba bzhengs/ /sngon gyi rgyus dang ngo mtshar dran bya'i phyir/ /sgo khyams lho mar bsam yas zhing bkod bzhengs/ / phyi rabs dad ldan gtsug lag gso ba dang*/ /bzo rigs mkhan rnams gnas 'dir 'byung bya'i phyir/ /sgo khyams byang mar da lta'i bzhengs tshul bkod/ / gtsug lag khang gi gnyer gtad bcol ba'i phyir/ /sgo rgyab yar lta yul lha gzhi bdag bzhengs/ /'khor 'das 'byung ldog rten 'brel shes bya'i phyir/

/sgo khang lho ngos srid pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ /snod bcud 'jig rten rang bzhin shes bya'i phyir/ /sgo khang byang ngos 'jig rten bstan bzhag bkod/ /mtha' dmag la sogs rgol ba bzlog pa dang*/ /yul gyi sa mtshams yongs su bsrung bya'i phyir/ /sgo khang steng ngos rigs gsum mgon po bzhengs/ /de ltar bzo rigs rten 'brel mthun gyur pa/ /mdo rgyud lung dang mkhas grub bzhed bzhin bkod/ /deng sang lugs bzhin rang bzo 'dod rgyal dang*/ /rten 'brel log pa'i gtsug lag ma yin pas/ /phyi rabs dus kyi g.yang tshe 'di la mdzod/ /'di phyi'i bkra shis bde legs 'byung ba yin/ /de ltar ngo mtshar gtsug lag khang chen yang*/ /bab col du ni rtsom pa ma yin te/ /ma lus 'gro phan bzang po'i sems bskyed nas/ /rmangs chos mnan pa chen po kha gsos la/ /bar chos rin chen chos kyi gter gsos shing*/ /lha rnams nang du 'phel gdung ring bsrel dang*/ / gzungs dang mchod rdzas bkra shis du ma bzhugs/ /rab tu gnas te bzhugs su gsol ba yin/ /'di dag dus su bgegs kun zhi ba dang*/ /ngo mtshar ya mtshan chen po'i ltas byung ba'i/ /che long tsam zha ི ga yongs su smos gyur na/ /gtsigs kyi khang bu mnan pa gso ba'i tshe/ /dar cig mun sros glo bur ser sprin g.yos/ /thams cad dngangs shing 'jigs su rung ba byung*/ /rjes la bkra shis nyi ma 'jam dros shar/ / bgegs rnams non zhing bde legs 'byung ba ste/ /rten 'brel legs pa'i thog mar byon pa lags/ /de nas bzung ste bzang po'i dus rnams dang*/ /bzo rigs gang zhig yongs su brtsams pa na/ /dwangs pa'i mkha' la 'od lnga'i mdangs gsal

zhing*/ /yid 'ong dge ba'i mtshan ma du ma mthong*/ /yang cig dgongs thun mun pa'i mtshams dag na/ /gser zhun lta bur mdzes pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /gtsug lag khang 'di sa gzhir bcas pa khyab/ /de 'dra'i snang ba ngo mtshar mchog gcig bkye/ / phyogs rnams lo legs 'khrug 'tshe zhi ba dang*/ /chom rkun med cing mgron po bde bar rgyu/ /lha yi yul bzhin re smon dam pa'i gzhi/ /mchog tu bstod gsum bde bar gyur pa lags/ /'di ni bdag gi mos dge phun tshogs dang*/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs dang*/ /khyad par o rgyan pad+ma'i thugs rje ste/ /bod 'bangs mi rnams ngo mtshar bya bar rigs/ /de ltar rmad du byung ba'i gtsug lag chen po 'di glang gi zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gcig la rmangs bres pa nas bzung ste/ zla ba bcu pa'i bar zla ba bdun/ ngo dang brgyad nas legs par 'grub ste/ bod spyi mthun gyi bsam pa 'grub pa lags so/ /phyi rabs kyi dad pa can dag gis kyang gtsug lag khang yongs su gso ba'i rim pa de ltar mdzad cing*/ khyad par du 'di yi rim pa gso lugs gong du smos pa bzhin te/ thog mar gtsigs kyi khang bu gsos la/ de nas 'di nyid mkhyen rab che ba dang*/ nus mthur ldan pas dang po ji ltar yod pa bzhin gso bar gdams te/ mkhyen pa snga nas che ba'i phyir ro/ /sngon gyi chos rgyal dam pa de dag gi /lhag pa'i thugs rje mchog tu zhugs gyur pas/ /pad+ma dbang chen gtsug lag khang gsos te/ /gangs ri'i yul 'dir mchog tu bde bar byas/ /lhag bsam rnam dag dad brgya'i rang bzhin gyis/ /ya mtshan 'phrul gyi bzo rig rnam bkod de/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'dir phyi rabs mis bsgrub rten//sprul pa 'dra zhes ngo mtshar bya ba'i rigs/ /de ltar yang dag phul du gyur pa'i gtsug lag khang la thog mar kun nas dge ba'i rab tu gnas pas bsod nams kyi zhing mchog dam par gyur pa ni/ sngon dang mtshungs par grub pa yin na/

de la kha cig 'di ci sngon ni 'phags pa rnams kyis mdzad la/ deng sang de ltar ma yin no snyam du dogs par mi bya ste/ byed pa po la khyad par yod kyang sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje la sngon dang*/ da ltar gyi khyad par med pas/ bya ba'i yul la byin rlabs dang thugs rje mtshungs par zhugs pas/ rgyal ba'i rten gsum sngon dang 'dra ba grub pa yin na ོ / /de'i 'thad pa yang gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa la mos pa tsam dang ldan pa'i mdun na yang bzhugs nas byin gyis rlob na/ bdag gis rgyud sde las byung ba'i cho ga ltar bsgrubs pas ci'i phyir byin gyis rlob par mi mdzad/ de yang yum bar ma las/ gang la la zhig gis de bzhin gshegs pa yid la byas te/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod na yang*/ de'i mdun du de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs so zhes dang*/ dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las/ gang du mos pas spyan drangs pas der de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang 'byon par 'gyur ra ོ / /zhes pa dang*/ gsang ba rgya mtsho las kyang*/ ting 'dzin rol mo bsam yas dang*/ sngags dang phyag rgyas dgug byas na/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kun/ /gshegs nas byin gyis rlob par mdzad/ /ces gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i rten la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ bskor ba dang*/ mchod pa byas pa las bsod nams mang du thob ste/ dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa las/ rgyal ba yi ni rten gsum la/ /dad pas thal mo sbyar na yang*/ /ngan 'gro log par mi ltung zhing*/ /lha dang mi yi dpal thob nas/ / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ 'jig rten 'di na bde zhing skyid pa kun/ /de kun dkon mchog mchod las byung bas na/ /rtag tu dkon mchog mchod la brtson par bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ klu'i bdag po de la mar me byin pas ni lha'i mi rnam par dag pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /de'ang da lta dkon mchog las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang*/

sngon sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i dus su bskrun pa la bsod nams khyad par med par thob ste/ mdo las/ rgyal ba mya ngan 'das pa dang*/ / gang dag da lta bzhugs pa la/ /gang gis dad pas gus mchod pa/ /sems dge ba nyid mtshungs pa'i phyir/ /bsod nams phung po mnyam par thob/ /ces gsungs sa ོ / /de ltar rten gsum ngo mtshar can bzhengs pa la bsod nams dpag tu med pa thob ste/ 'di ltar brtsams pa thams cad dge bas/ de'i phyogs la gtogs pa thams cad dge ba la bkod pa dang*/ rgyun ring bas dus phyi ma'i mthar kun gyi dge ba'i rten byed pas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ bskor ba byed pa la sogs pa'i bsod nams thams cad bzhengs pa las byung bas/ bzhengs pa pos de dag gi bsod nams kyi shas thob cing*/ /gzhan bskul ba'i dge ba thob pas/ 'dir yang tshe ring ba dang*/ nad med pa dang*/ chab srid mnga' thang che ba la sogs pa thob la/ phyi mar myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ra ོ / /ji skad du dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las/ gang gis bde gshegs sku gzugs sa dag gam/ /shing dang rdo dang zangs sam ro nye 'am/ /rin chen mang po dag la byas kyang rung*/ /de dag myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /byis pa rtsed mor dga' dang gsing ba dang*/ /rtsigs ngos dag la ri mo bris kyang rung*/ /sa rdul dag la phye ma'i mchod rten byed/ /de dag myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /ces pa dang*/ sgyu 'phrul las/ sa la sogs pas phyag rgya byas/ /rnam grol rim pa thob 'gyur na/ /lhag pa'i ye shes kyis sbyangs pas/ /smos ci dgos te de nyid yin/ /zhes pa dang*/ yum bar ma las/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ mchod rten de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can byas sam byed du bcug na bsod nams mang du 'phel lam gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo*/ /zhes pa la sogs pa mdo sde dpag tu med pa nas rgya cher gsungs pa bzhin na

ོ / /de ltar gtsug lag khang chen bzhengs pa yi/ /rlabs chen dge ba rgya mtsho'i mthar son nas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gyur pa'i 'gro ba kun/ / mngon par byang chub chos kyi rgyal po shog /ma lus nye bar zhi ba'i mkha' dbyings su/ /rang don zhi ba don du mi gnyer zhing*/ /sdug bsngal brgal dka'i chu bor ltung ba yi/ /skye dgu ma lus 'dren la brtson par shog /byed pa thams cad gzhan la phan brtson zhing*/ /byang chub sgrub la bar chad med pa dang*/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe mchog rab grub nas/ /skye shi med pa'i byang chub thob par shog /kun nas dga' ba'i dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /yon tan rin chen dge bas legs drangs te/ /kun dga'i bzang lam sa bcu rim bgrod nas/ /rin chen chos kyi rgyal srid 'dzin par shog /dge ba 'di yis dpal ldan gangs ri'i yul/ /lha dang mi yi bde skyid dpal 'bar zhing*/ /mtha' dmag 'byung po'i 'jigs pa med pa dang*/ /phyi nang 'khrugs 'tshe ma lus zhi gyur cig /lha mi mtshungs shing legs pa'i chos spyod la/ /skye dgu zhi bas phyogs rnams mdzes gyur cing*/ /phan tshun mthun pas nyin mtshan bkra shis gang*/ /rdzogs ldan dusabazhin nye bar gnas gyur cig /yul khams 'byor zhing mi rnams dar ba dang*/ /skyid cing nyams dga' dge legs phun sum tshogs/ /dus bzhir bkra shis lha yi 'jig rten bzhin/ /dpal ldan bsam dgu'i re ba 'grub gyur cig /khyad par mi mchog kun dga' rin chen gyi/ /sku tshe ring zhing chab srid brtan pa dang*/ /mnga' ris dpal 'byor sa skyong la reg pas/ /skye dgu'i kha lo gyen du sgyur bar shog /de ltar gnas skabs lha mi'i 'jig rten na/ /bde dga' rgya mtsho 'di dag rmi lam bzhin/ /mi rtag g.yo bar gyur pa'i tshul mkhyen nas/ /'pho gyur med pa'i byang chub 'grub par shog / mthar thug legs par zhi ba mchog gi lam/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po mchog dang 'khor rnams dang*/

/mnga' ris gtogs pa kun gyis legs bsgrubs nas/ / rang gzhan don gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shog /cis kyang snying po med pa'i 'khor ba la/ /mngon par dga' ba med pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /bshes gnyen dam pa ma lus mnyes byas te/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi myur du thob par shog /legs ldan 'byor pa sbyin pa'i bdag 'di dang*/ /slad ma'i dus na'ang smon lam mthun pa yis/ /ma lus 'gro ba kun gyi don byed cing*/ /dge ba'i lam bzang sgrub la brtson par shog /chags pa med yid can gyis sems can don/ /sprul 'drar byas nas gdod ma'i mkha' dbyings su/ /mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i sa bzung ste/ /mi g.yo lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas thob shog /skye shi med pa gnas lugs rig pa'i dbyangs/ /'pho 'gyur med pa byang chub sems kyi klong*/ /'du 'bral med pa rdo rje sems dpa'i ngang*/ / rang byung ye shes rig pas dbang bsgyung shog /de ltar mtha' yas bsod nams sprin chen las/ /byung ba'i dge ba'i char gyi tshogs bsil bas/ /'khor ba'i me tshogs ma lus rab gzhil nas/ /tshogs gnyis 'byor pa'i lo thog rnam 'phel shog /ji srid 'gro ba nye bar zhi ba yi/ /mkha' dbyings mchog der bdag gis ma bkod par/ /de srid sems can kun gyi don byed cing*/ /'jam dbyangs kun tu bzang dang mnyam par shog /tshul khrims dri med blo gros 'od zer gyis/ /'gro blo'i dge tshogs pad+mo rgyas byas nas/ /srid na 'ga' yang gnas par ma gyur te/ /thams cad byang chub 'byor pa mtha' yas shog /pad+ma dbang chen gtsug lag khang 'di yang*/ /skye dgu'i dpal mgon thar pa'i them skas su/ /bstan pa ji srid gnas bzhin gnas gyur te/ /'dis kyang bstan pa yun ring gnas byed shog /gtsug lag khang 'dir mchod pa'i sprin 'du bas/ /dad ldan rnams kyi bsod nams 'phel byed cing*/ /sdom brtson dam pa du mas brten gyur te/ /'chad dang kha ton grub pa 'phel bar shog

/nye 'khor rnams kyang lha yi yul bzhin du/ /skyid cing 'byor pa phun sum tshogs gyur te/ /dge ba'i lam la spro bas gnas gyur pa/ /dag pa'i zhing khams mchog dang mtshungs par shog /bdag kyang byang chub sems kyi shing rta las/ /dad pa'i yangs mig shes rab 'khor lo can/ /smon lam 'dun pa'i bzhon pas legs drangs nas/ /'gro kun thar pa'i grong du 'dren par shog /lha mi'i 'jig rten ma lus lha yul bzhin/ /mi yul bzhin du mngon mtho nges par legs/ /byang chub 'byor pa dam pas rab brgyan te/ /rgyal ba'i phun tshogs rgya mtsho mtha' yas shog /thar pa'i them skas gtsug lag khang 'di dang*/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje shin tu rmad byung gnyis/ /phun tshun 'gran pas skye dgu 'dren pa la/ /bsod nams stobs kyis yongs su bkod pa bzhin/ /de 'dra'i ngo mtshar gtsug lag khang chen 'di/ /phyi rabs don du gsos pas bod yul gyi/ /dad ldan mi dang dkar phyogs lha rnams dang*/ /yul lha gzhi bdag tshogs rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /tshul 'di blo gros yangs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /byams dang snying rje'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing*/ /rtsom 'chad rtsod pa'i 'od stong 'gyed pas sbyar/ /gangs can skye bo'i tshogs rnams dga' bar mdzod//dri med 'od zer snang bas rab phyes pa'i/ /rgyud 'byung pad+mo ngo mtshar sprang rtsis gtams//snyan tshig sdeb sbyor 'dab stong bkra ba des/ /blo gsal rkang drug ldan rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /zhwa pad+ma dbang chen gyi gtsug lag khang gi gtsigs kyi yi ge zhib mo bkod pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi gnas la mang du thos pa'i nor gyis phyug cing*/ theg pa mchog gi gnas la legs par sbyangs pa'i blo gros rgya che ba/ de kho na nyid kyi don la rnam par nges pa'i rtogs pas dbang 'byor pa'i chos smra ba kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang pos legs par sbyar ba rdzogs sa ོ / /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/
